title: Install adapted ACToR agent harness for spec-driven verification

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Adapting the vibe-fork/ACToR harness (proven in ferrotorch/ferrolearn/ferray) to Thermite's GREENFIELD spec-driven context. No upstream to translate, so the critic's external anchor becomes: (a) conformance corpus of hand-certified .th programs (cert oracle), (b) Verus/Kani/Z3 golden files for lowering components. Authority chain: design-doc -> component-design -> impl -> conformance/golden verification.

File manifest (pre-declared):
- goal.md (binding contract; R-SPEC replaces R-DEV upstream-mirror family)
- tooling/spec-discipline.py (rewrite of translate-discipline.py: reads = goal.md + design doc + optional route reference)
- tooling/anti-pattern-gate.py (ferray gate re-pointed to thermite-*/forge)
- tooling/spec-routes.toml (routes -> design docs -> conformance/golden refs; doubles as module map)
- .claude/agents/acto-{doc-author,builder,critic,fixer}.md
- .design/00-index.md
- .claude/settings.json (merge: + spec-discipline on PostToolUse:Read and PreToolUse:Write|Edit, + anti-pattern-gate on PreToolUse:Write|Edit)
- .gitignore (+ .crosslink/.spec-reads.json)

Reuses Thermite's existing crosslink hooks (work-check/prompt-guard/session-start/heartbeat/pre-web/post-edit) unchanged. State file: .crosslink/.spec-reads.json. Gated crates: thermite-*, forge.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
ACToR harness installed and smoke-tested. Files: goal.md; tooling/spec-discipline.py; tooling/anti-pattern-gate.py; tooling/spec-routes.toml (16 routes = v0.1 module map); .claude/agents/acto-{doc-author,builder,critic,fixer}.md; .design/00-index.md; settings.json merged (+spec-discipline on PostToolUse:Read and PreToolUse:Write|Edit, +anti-pattern-gate on PreToolUse:Write|Edit); .gitignore updated.

Verification (6/6 passed):
1. spec-discipline BLOCKS gated edit when design doc missing -> instructs acto-doc-author (exit 2)
2. spec-discipline ignores non-gated files (exit 0)
3. spec-discipline BLOCKS unrouted gated file -> instructs add route (exit 2)
4. anti-pattern-gate BLOCKS .unwrap() in gated file (exit 2)
5. anti-pattern-gate ALLOWS clean content (exit 0)
6. PostToolUse Read records goal.md in .crosslink/.spec-reads.json (exit 0)
settings.json parses; spec-routes.toml parses (16 routes); both hooks py_compile clean.

Greenfield adaptation vs canonical vibe-fork: upstream-read requirement replaced by design-doc(mandatory)+optional golden/conformance reference; R-DEV upstream-mirror family replaced by R-SPEC design-contract family; critic anchors on conformance corpus + Verus golden files. Reuses Thermite's existing crosslink hooks unchanged. Gates are LIVE this session. Not yet committed (awaiting user).
